title: The 24-Hour Content Loop: If I started over, I'd fix daily posting first
caption:
If I started over, I'd fix daily posting first

Audit yourself against this:
1️⃣ Capture one idea a day — Voice note or screenshot. The inbox feeds tomorrow's post, never a blank page.
2️⃣ Draft in one sitting — Two days of hooks, two days of bodies. Switching modes is what drains you.
3️⃣ Queue 3 days ahead — Always three posts loaded. A sick day never breaks the streak.
4️⃣ Re-post the winners — Every 30 days, refresh your best hook with a new angle. It already worked.

Score yourself in the comments.
